name: voice-bug-extension
description: Say "that's a bug" while testing; get a diagnosis in VS Code.

commands.title: Voice Bug: Set Gemini API Key
Voice Bug: Clear Gemini API Key

voiceBug.port.markdownDescription: Port the capture hub listens on (always `127.0.0.1`). `0` picks a free port each time. Set a fixed port when you need to forward it, e.g. when VS Code is connected to a GitHub Codespace.

voiceBug.devCommand.markdownDescription: Shell command run by **Voice Bug: Start Dev Server**. Its output is captured as `backend` events and shown in a terminal.

voiceBug.devCwd.markdownDescription: Working directory for `#voiceBug.devCommand#`. Empty means the monorepo root containing the first workspace folder (nearest `pnpm-workspace.yaml` etc. above it), or that folder itself; relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder.

voiceBug.geminiModel.markdownDescription: Gemini model used by **Diagnose Last Error**. Default: `gemini-3.8-flash` (free tier). Other free-tier options: `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`, `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`.

voiceBug.geminiFallbackModel.markdownDescription: Model to switch to when `#voiceBug.geminiModel#` stays overloaded (503) or rate-limited (429) after retries. Empty disables the fallback.

voiceBug.transcribeModel.markdownDescription: Gemini model that turns spoken utterances from the page overlay into text. Falls back to `#voiceBug.geminiFallbackModel#` if it fails.

voiceBug.geminiThinking.markdownDescription: How much the model thinks before answering. `low` is usually enough for a stack trace + source; higher is slower.

voiceBug.geminiTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Give up on a Gemini call after this many seconds.

voiceBug.sendScreenshots.markdownDescription: Send the two most recent page screenshots (taken after clicks and errors, with form values masked) to the model with the bundle, and show the latest in the panel.

voiceBug.ollamaModel.markdownDescription: Local [Ollama](https://ollama.com) model used when Gemini can't answer (overloaded, rate-limited or offline). Runs on your machine; nothing is sent anywhere. Empty disables it. Ignored if Ollama isn't running.

voiceBug.confirmBeforeSending.markdownDescription: Ask before sending the (redacted) bundle to Gemini. For voice reports, only the first send of each session asks.
